why: Popular Mechanics tested a power station as a home-office backup. It ran a laptop, a monitor and a fan for about 10 hours. That makes it a major reviewer answering part of this question with its own testing. Consumer Reports, TechRadar and OutdoorGearLab rank power stations in general, but none of them looks at the work-from-home case. Three results came back empty. So there is room for a new page, but it would be up against Popular Mechanics' tested pick and well-known general guides.
